title: Rust: decapsulate IPv6-in-IPv6 in plaintext Stack::receive path
description: b7z9.4.2 wired egress decap into the RPL receive path (receive.rs, both Absent local-delivery and SRH-consumed branches) but not Stack::receive (rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:527-584). There the survey now admits nh=41 packets addressed to the local address and hands the still-encapsulated outer to upper layers (which ignore it). Stack lacks local_rpl_addr; expected_dst could be the already-computed local_native (lichen_core::addr::ygg_addr_from_pubkey) if that is the authorized primary 02xx for that path. Reuse rpl_stack::util::decapsulate_ipv6. Add unit tests mirroring tests.rs decapsulate cases.
close_reason: Verification-close: already implemented at main. Stack::receive (rust/lichen-node/src/stack.rs:623-632) performs the egress decapsulation exactly as the bead specified: outer nh=41 (IPV6_IN_IPV6 — the const from b7z9.4.1, which also landed) addressed to the stack is unwrapped via rpl_stack::util::decapsulate_ipv6(&ipv6, local_native), fail-closed on inner-dst mismatch, with local_native = the authorized primary 02xx (ygg_addr_from_pubkey) — mirroring the RPL receive path per spec 05-routing 8.9 R-05-063. Unit tests exist and pass at main tip: stack_receive_decapsulates_tunnel_with_local_inner_dst (+ sibling IPV6_IN_IPV6 cases, tests.rs:1204+). Landed via b7z9.4.2's chain (3725304fe0 et al). No code change needed.
